You will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve agentic AI systems that execute real enterprise workflows. This is a hands-on technical leadership position. You will own projects from discovery and architecture through implementation, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. What You’ll Do? Lead, mentor, and technically support a team of junior AI and software engineers. Translate complex business requirements into clear and achievable engineering tasks. Help junior engineers strengthen their technical judgment, problem-solving capabilities, and engineering discipline. Arabic-language AI solutions and multilingual AI applications. Experience delivering solutions for banking, government, legal, IT operations, cybersecurity, or other regulated enterprise environments. Why Join Bright Brains This role provides the opportunity to join Bright Brains at an important stage of its growth and help shape a new AI division from the ground up . The Role We are seeking an experienced Venue Development Manager to lead the planning, development, delivery, and optimization of venues and destination-based facilities from initial concept through design, construction, opening, and ongoing enhancement. Conduct feasibility studies covering market demand, site suitability, capacity, commercial potential, operational requirements, and development costs. Develop venue concepts, functional requirements, development briefs, and project objectives. Evaluate potential sites, locations, properties, and development opportunities. Coordinate site assessments covering access, infrastructure, utilities, transportation, surrounding land uses, and development constraints. Develop business cases, financial models, capital budgets, development schedules, and investment recommendations. Coordinate master planning and venue development programs with internal and external stakeholders. Translate commercial and operational requirements into architectural and technical design requirements. Support tender evaluations, commercial negotiations, contract awards, and supplier onboarding. Manage development partners, contractors, consultants, and specialist service providers. Monitor contractor performance, construction progress, quality, cost, schedule, and compliance. Coordinate design reviews, technical workshops, constructability reviews, value-engineering exercises, and project approvals. Conduct regular project reviews and identify risks, delays, cost pressures, design issues, and resource constraints. Establish project risk registers and develop mitigation and contingency plans. Coordinate regulatory approvals, planning permissions, permits, inspections, certifications, and authority requirements. Ensure venue development complies with applicable building, fire, safety, accessibility, environmental, and operational requirements. Coordinate construction interfaces between architecture, structure, MEP, technology, security, audiovisual, interiors, signage, landscaping, and specialist systems. Support commissioning, testing, systems integration, operational readiness, and handover activities. Develop opening-readiness plans covering staffing, operating procedures, technology, facilities, security, guest services, maintenance, and emergency preparedness. Coordinate venue operational planning with future operators and functional teams. Ensure facilities, equipment, furniture, fixtures, technology, and operational assets are ready before opening. Support event simulations, trial operations, soft openings, test events, and operational rehearsals. Identify and resolve issues affecting venue readiness, customer experience, safety, or operational performance. Develop post-opening improvement plans based on operational data, customer feedback, event performance, and stakeholder input. Evaluate opportunities for venue expansion, refurbishment, repositioning, modernization, and capacity enhancement. Assess potential new revenue streams including events, sponsorship, hospitality, premium experiences, retail, food and beverage, memberships, and commercial partnerships. Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing, Sales, and Events teams to ensure venue development supports revenue objectives. Support development of venue operating models, business plans, pricing structures, service concepts, and commercial strategies. Analyze visitor profiles, market trends, competitor venues, event demand, utilization patterns, and customer expectations. Establish venue capacity, utilization, event-calendar, and revenue assumptions for development planning. Coordinate stakeholder engagement with investors, owners, government authorities, community representatives, operators, tenants, partners, and other relevant parties. Prepare executive reports, investment papers, project updates, decision documents, and development recommendations. Maintain comprehensive project documentation, approvals, drawings, specifications, contracts, budgets, schedules, and handover records. Establish governance frameworks, development standards, approval processes, and reporting requirements. Promote continuous improvement, innovation, digital transformation, and best practices in venue development. Evaluate emerging venue technologies, smart-building solutions, immersive experiences, sustainability technologies, and operational innovations. Ensure lessons learned from completed projects are incorporated into future venue-development programs. Experience working with architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, operators, and specialist suppliers. Strong understanding of building regulations, safety, accessibility, fire protection, and permitting requirements. Experience with construction quality management, commissioning, testing, and handover. Strong stakeholder-management and negotiation capabilities.
